# Accreditations

Browse who holds each accreditation and who to ask for guidance. Available to **all members**.

[← Back to features](README.md)

## Directory

Route: `/accreditations`

- Lists active accreditation types
- Expand a row to see:
  - **Holders** — members with an active assignment
  - **Who to ask** — mentors assigned to that accreditation (set by admins)

## Related

- Admins and authorised mentors manage types, assignments, and mentor contacts under [Manage accreditations](mentors.md)
- Exams can auto-grant an accreditation on pass — see [Forms](forms.md#exams-and-accreditations)
- Assignments also appear on [member profiles](members.md)
